name: D²-City
summary: 覆盖多种天气、道路和交通状况的大规模行车视频数据集，提供连续驾驶片段和场景标注，适合研究城市交通时序建模与分布泛化。
summaryEn: A large-scale dashcam video dataset spanning diverse weather, roads, and traffic conditions for urban driving dynamics and distribution generalization.
scale: Large-scale dashcam videos across diverse traffic and weather conditions
scaleZh: 覆盖多种交通和天气条件的大规模行车记录仪视频
organizationsZh: 阿里巴巴达摩院及合作团队
license: Project dataset terms; verify registration and downstream restrictions
licenseZh: 适用项目数据条款；需核查注册和下游限制
access: Paper entry; official access requires verification
accessZh: 论文入口；官方访问方式需核验
wmNote: 长时行车视频和环境多样性适合未来观测预测与鲁棒性研究，但动作和三维状态信号有限。
wmNoteEn: Long driving videos and environmental diversity support future-observation prediction and robustness studies, while action and 3D-state signals are limited.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1904.01975] D$^2$-City: A Large-Scale Dashcam Video Dataset of Diverse Traffic Scenarios
evidence.statement: Per-frame object tracking annotations across 1,000 driving videos expose road-user motion; single-keyframe detection subsets are not the inclusion basis.
